title: Data Analysis with Python
summary: pandas from the ground up, on a whole T20 cricket season: load data, ask it questions, clean it, group and join it, follow it over time and write up what you find. It ends with a season analysis report: teams, players and venues.
prereq: PY1 · Python Foundations at Beginner (variables, if, loops, lists, functions). No maths beyond averages and percentages. E2 helps but isn’t needed.
outcomes: Load CSV data into pandas and size it up: shape, types, totals, averages and counts.
Turn questions into filters, new columns, sorts and top-N tables.
Clean real data: blanks, wrong types, dates, repeats and inconsistent spellings.
Summarise with groupby, pivot tables and crosstabs, and combine tables with merge.
Follow numbers over time: dates, running totals, rolling averages and ranks.
Write up an analysis as a report someone else can act on.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.who: Anyone who wants to answer questions with data: students, analysts-to-be and curious fans.
levels.outcome: Load, filter, sort, summarise and clean a dataset, and answer clear questions about it.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.who: What D2, D3 and X1 expect, and what most data jobs ask for at interview.
levels.outcome: Reshape, join and time-series data with confidence, and pick the right summary for the question.

levels.name: Master
levels.who: People who will own analyses: robust, fast, and checked.
levels.outcome: Handle large, messy data quickly, test your assumptions, and write analyses others trust.

project.title: A T20 season analysis report: teams, players, venues
project.brief: A full season, ball by ball, becomes a report a team analyst could use. A checklist per level, hidden tests on another season and three “explain your code” questions.

modules.title: A first look at data
modules.summary: Load a season of a T20 league from a CSV file into pandas and get to know it: how big it is, what its columns hold, totals and averages of a column, and how often each value turns up. It ends with a season fact sheet, and Intermediate adds picking rows by position and by label.
